title: ADR 0020: zero-cost agent harness architecture and provider policy
problem: PO decision 2026-10-09: no spend-limit increase, budget 0, build a harness instead. Execution of ~350 tickets must run on free/local models, but no architecture or provider policy exists.
value: One decided design lets every other harness ticket proceed in parallel and keeps the zero-cost rule enforceable.
scope: Write audit/adr/0020-agent-harness.md: goals, non-goals, components (queue, provider layer, context packs, edit protocol, validation loop, review stage, merge gate, state), run location (user machine with local model; CI with free-tier APIs; cloud sessions cannot reach a local model)

Provider policy: OpenAI-compatible protocol only; classes local (Ollama, llama.cpp server, LM Studio, vLLM) and free-tier (verified at implementation time, quotas recorded in the ADR); paid endpoints refused unless the user passes an explicit --allow-paid flag
Secrets policy: provider keys only from environment variables, never in repo, never in logs
Define commit convention add(PLRNUI-<n>): msg, fix(PLRNUI-<n>): msg, chore(PLRNUI-<n>): msg and branch convention texo/PLRNUI-<n>-<slug> targeting integration branch texo/v1
outOfScope: Renaming package, repo or imports (Texo cutover is E15)
acceptance: audit/adr/0020-agent-harness.md exists with Status Accepted and headings Decision, Providers, Secrets, Run location, Git conventions, Alternatives (grep)
The ADR lists the exact environment variable names read for provider keys (grep 'HARNESS_')
The ADR states that main is never pushed or merged by the harness (grep)
risks: Free-tier quotas change; record the verification date and re-verify in E18-11
dod: All acceptance criteria verified by the listed commands
npm run typecheck and npm test green
No package/repo/import rename (00-brief)

value: Any ticket can run on whichever free/local model is available, with a hard zero-cost guarantee.

providers.config schema (name, baseUrl, apiKeyEnv, model, cost: local|free|paid, rpm, tpm, contextWindow) validated at load
Router: ordered fallback list, per-provider rate limiter, circuit breaker after 3 consecutive failures
Cost guard: any provider with cost 'paid' or unknown baseUrl is refused unless --allow-paid is set
Token ledger per run (prompt/completion tokens per provider) written to the run log

acceptance: Unit test: a provider marked paid is refused without --allow-paid and accepted with it

title: Harness context pack builder: minimal ticket context under a token budget

When E13 component cards exist, include the cards of referenced components instead of full docs
Emit a pack manifest listing every included file and its token estimate
